name: BMW
description: The BMW 5 Series in Carbon Black Metallic is a masterclass in executive motoring. With full service history, leather sport seats, and the latest iDrive 8 infotainment system, this car delivers unparalleled performance and comfort.

name: Mercedes-Benz
description: The Mercedes-Benz E-Class is the epitome of business-class luxury. Featuring the full MBUX system with dual 12.3-inch displays, Burmester surround sound, and comprehensive ADAS, every journey is extraordinary.

name: Audi
description: Audi's flagship saloon redefines understated luxury. The A6 quattro offers virtual cockpit, full matrix LED headlights, and full-length panoramic sunroof. A true driver's car that excels equally as a chauffeur vehicle.

name: Volvo
description: The Volvo XC90 T8 Recharge is the pinnacle of Scandinavian luxury. As a plug-in hybrid with Bowers & Wilkins sound, portrait display, and top safety scores, it is the safest 7-seat luxury SUV on the market.

name: Toyota Fortuner
description: Nearly new Toyota Fortuner with the powerful GD-6 diesel engine and 4WD system. Built for both city roads and tough terrain, 7 seats, modern safety features, and Toyota's legendary reliability.

name: Mahindra Thar LX
description: The iconic Mahindra Thar — India's most loved off-roader reborn for the modern era. Waterproof touchscreen, soft-top convertible, and 4x4 with low-range make it equally at home on city streets or jungle trails.

name: Hyundai Creta SX
description: A near-new Hyundai Creta SX with turbo petrol engine and dual-clutch transmission. Panoramic sunroof, Bose 8-speaker audio, and BlueLink connected car tech — the smartest compact SUV you can buy.

name: Kia Seltos HTX+
description: The Kia Seltos HTX+ delivers a premium experience at a sensible price. 10.25-inch touchscreen, Bose sound, ventilated seats, and segment-first air purifier — this is the benchmark compact SUV.

name: Tata Harrier Dark
description: The Tata Harrier Dark Edition on its Land Rover-derived platform is one of the most striking SUVs on Indian roads. JBL 9-speaker audio, panoramic sunroof, and a commanding road presence for the best value premium SUV.

name: Honda City 5th Gen
description: The 5th-gen Honda City continues to be the gold standard in the premium sedan segment. Sporty exterior, 8-inch touchscreen, Honda Sensing safety suite, and the smooth i-VTEC CVT make it an irresistible package.

name: Volkswagen Virtus GT
description: The VW Virtus GT with 1.5 TSI EVO is the most driver-focused sedan in its segment. 150PS turbocharged performance, 7-speed DSG, and a 10-inch glass touchscreen make it extraordinary value.

name: Maruti Ciaz Alpha
description: The Maruti Ciaz Alpha with SHVS mild-hybrid tech delivers outstanding fuel economy. Premium leatherette seats, a large boot, and class-leading cabin space make it the family-friendly sedan choice.

name: Maruti Swift ZXi+
description: India's best-selling hatchback, now better than ever. LED headlamps, 9-inch SmartPlay Pro+ touchscreen, and the peppy Z-Series engine make it the perfect city companion. Nearly new condition with low mileage.

name: Hyundai i20 Asta
description: The Hyundai i20 Asta Turbo is the most feature-rich premium hatchback in India. Sunroof, Bose sound, digital instrument cluster, and the punchy 1.0T engine deliver a genuine premium experience in a compact package.

name: Tata Altroz XZ+
description: India's safest hatchback with a 5-star Global NCAP rating. 10.25-inch touchscreen, JBL sound, 360° camera, and a turbocharged 110PS engine — the Altroz proves safety and fun go hand in hand.

name: Renault Kwid Climber
description: The Renault Kwid Climber with AMT is the most affordable SUV-inspired hatchback available. 8-inch touchscreen, Android Auto, and the proven 1.0L SCe engine offer urban mobility at an unbeatable price.
